document.title: Follow first, then freebie

source.badge_text_exact: UPGRADEUpgrade required: This feature requires upgrading your plan to access.
source.description_exact: Wanna freebie? Gotta follow first. Reward the fans, not the lurkers.
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Grow followers with a freebie
Business value
It’s a Trojan horse for follower growth. You’re delivering value while subtly strong-arming people into hitting follow. Everyone wins. Especially you.
How does it work?
Set up Manychat to check if someone follows your account before delivering the freebie. Works across ALL your Reels. Comment triggers it, Manychat checks their follow status, and hands over the goods only if they qualify.
Back To List
Set Up Template
